scope: One live opportunity/pressure diagnosis pair, not formal average or oracle execution.
fanout_policy: Prompt-selected 2-4 same-response task calls; initial named task with explicit parallel calls and a repeat-capable BeliefKV constraint. Full tool prompt stays unchanged; no fanout rejection, forced cancellation or invented children.

superseded_attempt.reason: Initial auto requests bypassed delegation; local named-task XGrammar also restricted output to one call before the v8b ingress repair.

prediction_status: Frozen v7 heads under changed pressure/fanout, not assumed recalibrated. Complete JOIN=max actual member RETURN; early parent restoration only for the last observed unfinished ALL member.
metrics: native/predictive H2D and D2H bytes, CUDA event service, submit-ACK and queue budget
same-session previously served common input-prefix loss, separate from new input
complete bounded Host eviction probes, FULL attribution and Mamba uncertainty
terminal leaf ancestry device/host residency, locks and refs with later snapshots
session close start/ACK/failure and latency, not physical reclamation
actual per-round fanout, multiround count, tool/child/whole JOIN time errors
all outcomes, interventions, realized work, first reuse and wasted/expired prefetch
limits: No canary, automatic 128-root escalation, artificial eviction, new agent guard or action-benefit head. H2D time is not a whole-system oracle upper bound. Shared terminal ancestry is not exclusive dead data.
